dynamic_families.message_expression: format ! ( "Embedding asset exceeds its size limit: {}" , path . display ( ) )
format ! ( "Input exceeds the local HTTP tokenizer limit of {} tokens." , check . limit )
format ! ( "Unsupported index structure at {}. Rebuild index.sqlite with sync --rebuild; an unsupported vectors.sqlite cache may be removed for recomputation." , path . display ( ) )

if error . code == "embedding_input_too_large" { "Composed input exceeds its byte or tokenizer limit." } else { "Embedding endpoint rejected this individual input; inspect content and model configuration, then retry failed inputs." }
format ! ( "Credential {id} was issued, but its file could not be saved. Revoke it with credential revoke {id}: {}" , e . message )
format ! ( "{}; service restart failed: {}" , result . message , restart . restart )
format ! ( "Service environment is missing: {}" , missing . join ( ", " ) )
format ! ( "Owned service environment file needs: {}. No model change was made." , missing . join ( ", " ) )
